page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for workloads requiring dedicated parallel processing capabilities. It features an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz, delivering 28 dedicated physical cores and 28 vCPUs on an x86_64 architecture. The system is equipped with 112 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. Additionally, it includes a bundled 472 GB local SSD for storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps.

The defining hardware component of this instance is the single NVIDIA P100 GPU from the Pascal family, which features 16 GB of dedicated VRAM. In benchmark testing, this hardware configuration demonstrates distinct performance profiles. While single-core CPU performance is poor, ranking in the bottom 10% on stress-ng, multi-core CPU performance and memory bandwidth read/write operations fall within the average range. Notably, the instance excels in LLM inference tasks, achieving top-tier performance in prompt processing for both small and medium models, as well as text generation for medium models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge offers a balanced resource density for legacy GPU workloads, combining dedicated compute cores, local SSD storage, and hardware acceleration without the premium cost of newer-generation GPU architectures. However, users should note the tradeoff of weaker single-threaded CPU performance. This server is best suited for workloads such as medium-scale machine learning inference, data science tasks, multi-threaded data processing, and database operations that can leverage GPU acceleration and multi-core CPU execution.
